description: Therapeutic products newly registered in Singapore by HSA on or after a date, from each product's approval date, newest first. Covers NEW REGISTRATIONS only: the listing holds only currently registered products and no cancellation or variation date, so withdrawals are invisible and the response says so (removals_visible:false). Returns comparable:false with a reason, never a misleading zero, when the date is later than the published data.

since.description: Earliest approval date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: hsa_sg_recent_changes
